text_block_list.text: An umamusume—

Born with the names of another world, 
carrying histories sometimes bizarre, 
sometimes glorious, they inherit those 
souls and run... That is their destiny.
They were born to run.
Therefore, that soul yearns—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Faster—!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: More—more, more, more, more!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
With unprecedented speed! Toward that 
light ahead!
To reach the pinnacle of speed.

On the way to the track, the chime 
signaling the start of training rang out. 
The lively chatter of students began to 
drift from the school building.
(...*rumble rumble rumble rumble*)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!

Right beside me, an Umamusume rushed past 
at an astonishing speed.

Yet right in her path stood a massive 
tree—!
choice_data_list: Look out! Dodge!

text_block_list.text: (THUUUUD!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaah! Ow, ow, ow!

The umamusume—Calstone Light O—crashed 
head-on into a tree in her path. She is 
rolling around on the ground in agony.
choice_data_list: Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, I'm fine. Bumping into things is 
an everyday occurrence for me.
choice_data_list: No, at least try to dodge a little?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If I swerve, I'll decelerate. If I 
decelerate, I won't be running my fastest. 
I don't want that.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Oops, the other students are here. Well 
then!

No sooner had she spoken than Calstone 
Light O bolted away.

"—A speed that leaves the wind behind. No 
matter how many times I see it, I'm 
utterly captivated."

What first piqued my interest in her was 
an incident just like today's. I thought 
she was a strange girl, but—

"Watching that run captivated my heart. A 
speed that transcended the limits of an 
Umamusume. Her figure was like a single 
beam of light."

I want to pursue her speed. With that 
thought, I signed a contract to become her 
exclusive trainer. I look forward to the 
next three years walking alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It has been a short while, Trainer. Would 
you like to hear today's results? Then 
allow me to report.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I was the first to arrive today too! Being 
fast really does feel great.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
However, I should be able to run faster. 
If only I could take the shortest route.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The academy won't grant permission. Even 
though it's been a long time since I 
applied.
choice_data_list: What's the shortest route?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
From the classroom to the outside. If you 
run along the walls, it's a straight line.
choice_data_list: Run along the wall?! That's impossible!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If it's just going downhill, we might have 
a shot!
choice_data_list:
No, it's too dangerous! Your debut is 
coming up soon, too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "However... huh? Debut?"

Taking advantage of a pause in Calstone 
Light O's speech, I told her that her 
debut date had been set.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Ohh! Finally, my debut is...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I am happy. Incredibly happy. I feel like 
sprinting right this second with a loud 
'Wasshoi!'

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: And so, I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Wasshooooii!!

Shouting with pure joy, Calstone Light O 
bolted out onto the track.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*... Now I feel satisfied.
choice_data_list:
Then, shall we discuss our policy going 
forward?

text_block_list.text:
I informed her that her Make Debut would 
be in June, a 1200m sprint, requiring a 
trip to Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Kyoto Racecourse is a clockwise track. You 
avoided the counter-clockwise tracks I 
struggle with, didn't you? Good job!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Let's aim for top speed. Naturally. Now 
then, after the Make Debut—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: The Sprinters Stakes.
choice_data_list: So fast, so fast...

text_block_list.text:
In the first place, Junior-tier Umamusume 
are not eligible to run in the Sprinters 
Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see. Any race is fine by me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
To reach the highest speed in history. If 
only I could run like that.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A speed no one, no living creature, has 
ever reached. Surpassing even the speed of 
light.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I want to go beyond that.

Calstone Light O wishes to pursue speed to 
the absolute limit.

Conversely, she doesn't place much 
importance on winning. She goes so far as 
to say she has no intention of scrapping 
for a win if it means sacrificing speed.

Still, in the Twinkle Series, you can't 
enter higher-tier races without building 
up a certain track record.

To become faster, it is also necessary to 
compete against strong opponents. Strong 
Umamusume gather in graded stakes.

Therefore, my role is to polish their 
speed while guiding them to victory in 
their races.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Once the debut is set, the training 
routine will change as well, right?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I made a plan, so let's go over it.

text_block_list.text:
Until her debut was decided, we stuck to 
basic training. It was essentially an 
extension of our pre-contract training.

However, making her debut also meant her 
body was reaching its prime development 
stage.

First, we'll adjust the basic training 
toward body conditioning. It's to build up 
your muscular strength and stamina.

Because sprints are so short, each stride 
must generate tremendous propulsion. 
Muscle strength directly equates to speed.

Also, in order to finish the race without 
losing significant speed, even sprinters 
require a baseline level of stamina.

After that, I tell her we will thoroughly 
correct her form.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Form correction?
choice_data_list:
Form is the most important thing for 
hitting top speed.

Form is the most important thing for 
hitting top speed, you know.

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Calstone Light O's immense 
natural talent, she was fast even with her 
own style. But fixing her form alone 
should easily increase her top speed.

Efficiently converting the kick's force 
into propulsion. Navigating the corners 
smoothly. Every bit of it is governed by 
your running form.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
You pointed it out to me before, didn't 
you? That I have a habit of veering to the 
right.
choice_data_list:
Right, it's because your core isn't strong 
enough to maintain form.

Right, it's because your core is too weak 
to keep your form.

text_block_list.text:
If your core is weak, your center axis 
will wobble. When that happens, your 
kicking power won't transfer straight into 
the ground, and a portion of that power 
gets lost.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
! What a waste! This won't do. Let's fix 
this from the ground up!
choice_data_list:
Next, let's measure your peak 
instantaneous speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, top instantaneous speed too? That 
makes it really easy to see how much 
faster they've gotten!
choice_data_list:
However, there's one thing I want you to 
remember.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: What is it?

This training plan was designed with a 
long-term perspective in mind.

Because of that, visible results won't 
appear right away. The payoff is expected 
to show once her body matures during her 
growth spurt—around the summer of the 
Classic year.

Until her body develops properly, we 
should hold back on excessive training. 
That is why her stats might not always 
show immediate growth.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you're saying not to let numbers 
dictate my emotions.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. But you'll definitely reach top 
speed.

Yeah. But you'll definitely be able to 
reach top speed.

text_block_list.text:
Since she prefers high speed, she might 
find this frustrating. However—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Understood. So you believe that to be the 
best course of action.
choice_data_list: That's right.
That's right.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I believe you. Because you are my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The training plan is convincing as well. I 
have no objections.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, you were so on the ball it 
startled me. Were you abducted by aliens 
or something?"
choice_data_list: Wait, what did you think of me until now?!
Wait, what did you think of me until now?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I mean it from the bottom of my 
heart!

"Isn't that the part where one is supposed 
to say 'just kidding'... She is truly open 
to a fault."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that really makes my debut feel 
real! I'm so excited!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
“—Aiming to run at maximum speed. I'm 
counting on you, Trainer!”
